summary: Air-date lane only. Stored ep 50 (2010-01-24) is in fact ep 42's date; the real broadcast of 第50話「怒りの最終決戦」 was 2010-03-21, the Sunday between ep 49 (03-14) and ep 51 (03-28). Three sources agree. One repair, no true deviation.

repairs.why: ja-WP メタルファイト ベイブレード 各話リスト: 第50話 怒りの最終決戦 = 3月21日 (2010); en-WP Beyblade: Metal Fusion season 1 = March 21, 2010; syoboi Count 50 = 2010-03-21 08:30 (TXN). Stored 2010-01-24 is 第42話「ドラゴンの制裁」's date — a mis-join, not a typo of 03-21.

structure.notes: Weekly Sunday 08:30 TV Tokyo slot, no hiatus in the Feb–Mar 2010 block; 51 rows = 第1話–第51話.
